Definition: Ater, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Three men carry the name Ater in the records of the return, and the lists keep their families apart. One is the head of a family that came back with Zerubbabel, one is the father of the porters, and one sealed the covenant in Nehemiah's day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the three Aters show how the returned exiles rebuilt by family, and each household had its part in the work.
